item.title: Koorlian Mattresses Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability; Sold on Amazon by Dream Bedding Technology
item.company: Dreams Bedding Technology PTE. Ltd., of Singapore
item.brand: Dreams Bedding Technology PTE. Ltd., of Singapore
item.summary: This recall involves Koorlian branded mattresses. The mattresses are 10 inches thick and were sold in a Twin XL size. They have a white top and blue sides and were sold compressed in a box. "Dreams Bedding Technology PTE LTD" the manufacture date and prototype ID "KY15Q290" are printed on a sewn-in white label located on one side of the mattress.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattress immediately and contact Dreams Bedding Technology to receive a free cover to put over their mattress to bring it into compliance with the mandatory flammability standards.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
